caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a long, formal gown on a featureless, headless mannequin. The gown is mainly a light cream or beige color and features elaborate floral embroidery in multiple colors including green, pink, red, blue, and purple. The floral patterns are present along the wide neckline, down the front panels of the dress, on the sleeves, and in horizontal bands on the lower skirt. The dress has full, flowing skirts that appear to be composed of an outer layer parted in the front to reveal a similarly decorated underskirt. The bodice is fitted, with three-quarter length sleeves that are loose and slightly flared, edged with the same floral embroidery. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing showing the back view of the gown, which displays the long, voluminous skirt and fitted bodice, with details indicating the construction and fit. The background is plain and light tan in color, which contrasts subtly with the gown.
title: Ball Dress
